claim: Integrate admitted needs, route-free native requests, recorded historical pressure, suspension and explicit fulfillment. Fulfillment requires an exact fully paid native movement output consumed by a later fully paid native operation in the same actor, context and semantic target. A selected route, completed comparison or movement label never suffices.

implementation_limit.bounded_evaluation: both content settings, 28 exact FT4.1 methods and declared integration controls

controller: One versioned controller owns only the demand ledger and controller-event order. Native engines retain ownership of access, payment, jobs, outputs and wallets.
Each cycle observes the actor view and historical state, admits or suspends exact owned needs, records pressure, then forms at most one route-free native request by the accepted b1 policy.
Unscoped pressure is visible but cannot fabricate a task or request. Missing, disputed, retracted, inaccessible or unsupported work remains visible and unfulfilled.
Settlement accepts a named demand, selection job, native movement job and later consumer job. It does not execute or repair them. Repeated settlement is idempotent.
Exact checkpoint restoration preserves ledger, event order, pending work and the next request.
fulfillment: The admitted demand is current, pending and actor-owned at settlement.
The comparison job succeeded with complete paid extent and its exact input demand equals the admitted binding.
The native movement job succeeded with complete paid route extent and is the comparison decision's actual child.
The later consumer succeeded with complete paid route extent, consumes the exact movement output and has the same actor, context and semantic target as the demand.

Consumer output must be an actual native result. Failure, cancellation, partial work, missing output, wrong scope, wrong actor, stale demand, label-only evidence and unsupported output preserve pending status.
audit: Independently reconstruct admission, current ownership, comparison, child linkage, payment, realized movement output, later exact consumption and demand scope from raw native journal/access evidence plus controller events. The auditor may use record codecs and structural constants but may not import the demand controller, request generator, participant selector, scheduler or executors.
gate: All ten exact integration methods and all twenty accepted admission/request methods pass with unchanged frozen source. Canonical and workflow positive witnesses must be independently reconstructed. Parent FT4.1 passes only this demand-formation gate; FT4.2 route-choice and FT4.3 autonomous closure/reuse remain open.
next_batch: FT4.2: connect the integrated controller to lawful paid choice among ordinary, n, cp, consenting support and deferral under owned evidence and affordability.
